content.short: Double Protocol is an NFT rental protocol and marketplace, and is associated with ERC 4907, an Ethereum Standard.
content.description: Double Protocol provides a platform for renting NFTs used in games, metaverses, and other experiences, allowing users to access NFT utility without owning the assets. As NFT functionality expands beyond collectibles, the demand to use NFTs on demand grows. The project advocates for new standards such as ERC-4907 and ERC-5006 (extensions of ERC-721 and ERC-1155, respectively) that enable NFT rentals securely without collateral, supporting borrowing and on-chain use across multiple chains and marketplaces.
